subject: Game Theory
title: Why Both Confess
description: A quick, practical guide to Why Both Confess.

hook.text: Imagine you're a suspect. If you betray and your partner stays silent, you walk completely free.

buildup.text: If you stay silent and they betray, you get the worst sentence. Betrayal protects you either way.

discovery.text: Each prisoner reasons alone and concludes betrayal is safer no matter what the other does.

twist.text: Both think the same way. Both betray. Both end up worse than if they'd trusted each other.

climax.text: The dilemma shows how individual logic can produce collectively irrational outcomes.

punchline.text: Logic says betray. Trust says cooperate.

quiz.question: Why does each prisoner choose to betray?
options: Betrayal is safer regardless of the other's choice
